Name: Babel Rising 3D
Description: Play a wrathful god bent on stopping humanity from raising the Tower of Babel. Rain down elemental wrath — boulders, meteor showers, tidal waves and sandstorms — to crush the workers and topple the tower before it reaches the heavens. A 3D reimagining of the god-game by Mando Productions, published by Ubisoft.

Achievements.Name: Falling Stone
Achievements.Description: Crush 20 workers with one giant boulder.

Achievements.Name: Great Balls of Fire
Achievements.Description: Damage 5 tower blocks with one meteor shower.

Achievements.Name: Holy Wave
Achievements.Description: Use a tidal wave that spares cursed jar bearers.

Achievements.Name: Blown Away
Achievements.Description: Use a sand storm to send a worker flying far away.

Achievements.Name: Apocalypse
Achievements.Description: Earn the highest distinction by performing power combos.

Achievements.Name: Patient God
Achievements.Description: Use two distinct level 3 powers in a single game.

Achievements.Name: Eclectic God
Achievements.Description: Use each passive power and each scroll once.

Achievements.Name: Cursed!
Achievements.Description: Destroy 15 cursed jars in a single game.

Achievements.Name: Survivor
Achievements.Description: Survive 5 minutes when the tower is almost complete.
